"""Supplementary mandatory repetitions, real crash evidence and SQL bypasses."""
import dataclasses,json,os,signal,subprocess,sys,threading,time
import psycopg,pytest
from agent_guard.contracts.execution import ExecutionError,ToolId
from agent_guard.contracts.ledger import AcceptDisposition,LedgerError,ErrorCode
from agent_guard.execution import store as es
from tests.fixtures.execution import build_env,order_params,notification_params,read_params,expire_lease
from tests.fixtures.state import build_tree
from tests.fixtures.dbstate import fetch_counts
from test_review import accepted,observe,counters,effects

@pytest.mark.parametrize('stage',['partial-node','after-event','after-outbox'])
def test_real_partial_terminal_rollback(a2,monkeypatch,stage):
 op=accepted(a2).operation_id
 target={'partial-node':'apply_terminal_counters','after-event':'insert_terminal_event','after-outbox':'insert_pending_receipt'}[stage]
 original=getattr(es,target)
 def fail(*args,**kwargs):
  if stage=='partial-node':original(args[0],args[1][:1])
  else:original(*args,**kwargs)
  raise RuntimeError('after actual partial SQL writes')
 monkeypatch.setattr(es,target,fail)
 with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):a2.service.run_operation(op,owner_token='partial-owner')
 state={'stage':stage,'counters':counters(a2),'counts':fetch_counts(a2.gateway_dsn),'status':a2.service.operation_status(op),'effects':effects(a2)}
 assert state['status']=='EXECUTING' and state['counts']['ag_ledger_events']==1 and state['counts']['ag_ledger_event_nodes']==3 and state['counts']['ag_receipt_outbox']==0
 assert all(v=={'amount_reserved':70000,'amount_settled':0,'calls_reserved':1,'calls_settled':0} for v in state['counters'])
 monkeypatch.setattr(es,target,original)
 assert a2.service.run_operation(op,owner_token='partial-owner').status=='SUCCEEDED'
 assert effects(a2)['ds_orders']==1 and fetch_counts(a2.gateway_dsn)['ag_receipt_outbox']==1
 observe('partial-rollback',state)

@pytest.mark.parametrize('round_no',range(10))
@pytest.mark.parametrize('mode',['same','revoke','replay','altered','new-key'])
def test_p11_actual_miss_recheck_and_rejection_variants(a2,monkeypatch,mode,round_no):
 key='race-key';first_key='new-key' if mode=='new-key' else key
 env=build_env(tree=a2.tree,gateway_dsn=a2.gateway_dsn,downstream_dsn=a2.downstream_dsn)
 params=order_params(items=(('sku-001',2),)) if mode=='altered' else order_params()
 inv=a2.tree.invocation(idempotency_key=first_key,jti='shared-proof' if mode=='replay' else 'first-proof',tool_id=ToolId.ORDER_CREATE.value,params=params)
 missed=threading.Event();committed=threading.Event();original=env.service._find_candidate;times=[]
 def lookup(v):
  row=original(v);times.append(row is not None)
  if len(times)==1:
   assert row is None;missed.set();assert committed.wait(10)
  return row
 monkeypatch.setattr(env.service,'_find_candidate',lookup)
 result=[]
 def first():
  try:result.append(env.service.accept_invocation(inv,env.permission()))
  except Exception as e:result.append(e)
 thread=threading.Thread(target=first);thread.start();assert missed.wait(10)
 second=a2.service.accept_invocation(a2.tree.invocation(idempotency_key=key,jti='shared-proof' if mode=='replay' else 'second-proof',tool_id=ToolId.ORDER_CREATE.value,params=order_params()),a2.permission())
 if mode=='revoke':
  from agent_guard.ledger.provisioning import revoke_grant
  with psycopg.connect(a2.gateway_dsn) as c:revoke_grant(c,a2.tree.mid_id)
 env.catalog.remove_quote('quote-001','1');committed.set();thread.join(15);assert not thread.is_alive() and len(result)==1
 r=result[0]
 if mode=='same':assert r.disposition is AcceptDisposition.EXISTING and r.operation_id==second.operation_id and r.cost==second.cost
 elif mode=='new-key':assert isinstance(r,ExecutionError)
 else:assert isinstance(r,LedgerError) and r.code is {'revoke':ErrorCode.REVOKED,'replay':ErrorCode.REPLAY,'altered':ErrorCode.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT}[mode]
 assert times==[False,mode!='new-key'] and fetch_counts(a2.gateway_dsn)['ag_operations']==1 and fetch_counts(a2.gateway_dsn)['ag_ledger_events']==1
 assert all(v=={'amount_reserved':70000,'amount_settled':0,'calls_reserved':1,'calls_settled':0} for v in counters(a2)) and effects(a2)['ds_orders']==0
 observe('p11-repeat',{'mode':mode,'round':round_no,'lookups':times,'result':type(r).__name__})

def test_notification_concurrent_effects_ten_rounds(a2):
 with psycopg.connect(a2.gateway_dsn) as c:tree=build_tree(c,root_calls=100,mid_calls=100,leaf_calls=100)
 env=build_env(tree=tree,gateway_dsn=a2.gateway_dsn,downstream_dsn=a2.downstream_dsn)
 ref=env.service.accept_invocation(tree.invocation(tool_id=ToolId.REQUEST_READ.value,params=read_params()),env.permission()).operation_id
 assert env.service.run_operation(ref).status=='SUCCEEDED'
 for i in range(10):
  params=notification_params(operation_id=ref);op=env.service.accept_invocation(tree.invocation(idempotency_key='note-'+str(i),tool_id=ToolId.NOTIFICATION_SEND.value,params=params),env.permission()).operation_id
  barrier=threading.Barrier(2);results=[]
  def call():
   barrier.wait();results.append(env.downstream.execute(service_secret=env.secret,operation_id=op,tool_id=ToolId.NOTIFICATION_SEND,canonical_params=params,quote=None,expected_amount_fen=0))
  ts=[threading.Thread(target=call) for _ in range(2)]
  for t in ts:t.start()
  for t in ts:t.join(10)
  assert not any(t.is_alive() for t in ts) and len(results)==2 and len({r.effect_ref for r in results})==1 and sorted(r.already_existed for r in results)==[False,True]
  assert env.service.reconcile(op).status=='SUCCEEDED'
  assert effects(env)['ds_notifications']==i+1
  assert all(v=={'amount_reserved':0,'amount_settled':0,'calls_reserved':0,'calls_settled':i+2} for v in counters(env))
  assert fetch_counts(env.gateway_dsn)['ag_receipt_outbox']==i+2
 observe('notification-concurrency',{'rounds':10,'effects':effects(env),'counters':counters(env)})

def test_owned_real_process_kill_and_restart_evidence(a2,tmp_path):
 op=accepted(a2).operation_id
 env={k:os.environ[k] for k in ['PATH','PYTHONPATH'] if k in os.environ}
 env.update(AG_WORKER_GATEWAY_DSN=a2.gateway_dsn,AG_WORKER_DOWNSTREAM_DSN=a2.downstream_dsn,AG_WORKER_SERVICE_SECRET=a2.secret,AG_WORKER_OPERATION_ID=op,AG_WORKER_APPROVED_SUPPLIERS='supplier-001',AG_WORKER_APPROVED_RECIPIENTS='user-demo-001',AG_WORKER_SERVED_REQUESTS='req-001',AG_WORKER_OWNER_TOKEN='review-killed')
 sync=tmp_path/'sync.json';env.update(AG_WORKER_SYNC_FILE=str(sync),AG_WORKER_RELEASE_FILE=str(tmp_path/'never-release'))
 proc=subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,'-m','agent_guard.execution.worker'],env=env,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True)
 try:
  deadline=time.monotonic()+20
  while time.monotonic()<deadline:
   if sync.exists() and sync.stat().st_size:break
   time.sleep(.02)
  assert sync.exists();seen=json.loads(sync.read_text());assert seen['pid']==proc.pid and seen['outcome_seen']
 finally:
  proc.kill();proc.wait(10)
 assert proc.returncode==-signal.SIGKILL
 killed={'pid':proc.pid,'exit':proc.returncode,'status':a2.service.operation_status(op),'counts':fetch_counts(a2.gateway_dsn),'counters':counters(a2),'effects':effects(a2)}
 assert killed['status']=='EXECUTING' and killed['effects']['ds_orders']==1 and killed['counts']['ag_receipt_outbox']==0 and killed['counts']['ag_ledger_events']==1
 expire_lease(a2.gateway_dsn,op);env.pop('AG_WORKER_SYNC_FILE');env.pop('AG_WORKER_RELEASE_FILE');env['AG_WORKER_OWNER_TOKEN']='review-restarted'
 other=subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,'-m','agent_guard.execution.worker'],env=env,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True)
 stdout,stderr=other.communicate(timeout=30);assert other.returncode==0 and other.pid!=proc.pid
 payload=json.loads(stdout);assert payload['status']=='SUCCEEDED' and payload['previous_status']=='EXECUTING' and payload['fencing_version']==2
 assert effects(a2)['ds_orders']==1 and fetch_counts(a2.gateway_dsn)['ag_ledger_events']==2 and fetch_counts(a2.gateway_dsn)['ag_ledger_event_nodes']==6 and fetch_counts(a2.gateway_dsn)['ag_receipt_outbox']==1
 assert all(v=={'amount_reserved':0,'amount_settled':70000,'calls_reserved':0,'calls_settled':1} for v in counters(a2))
 observe('process-restart',{'killed':killed,'restart_pid':other.pid,'restart_exit':other.returncode,'result':payload,'final_counters':counters(a2),'final_effects':effects(a2)})

def test_downstream_wait_must_be_bounded(a2):
 with a2.downstream._connect() as c:
  settings=c.execute("SELECT current_setting('connect_timeout', true),current_setting('statement_timeout'),current_setting('lock_timeout')").fetchone()
 observe('downstream-deadlines',{'statement_timeout':settings[1],'lock_timeout':settings[2]})
 assert settings[1]!='0' and settings[2]!='0', 'downstream SQL waits unbounded after bounded connect'

@pytest.mark.parametrize('phase',['RESERVE','SETTLE'])
def test_cannot_append_nodes_to_committed_immutable_event(a2,phase):
 op=accepted(a2).operation_id;a2.service.run_operation(op)
 outbox=a2.service.outbox_entry(op)
 refused=False
 with psycopg.connect(a2.gateway_dsn) as c:
  eid=c.execute('SELECT event_id FROM ag_ledger_events WHERE operation_id=%s AND phase=%s',(op,phase)).fetchone()[0]
  try:
   with c.transaction():c.execute('INSERT INTO ag_ledger_event_nodes (event_id,position,grant_id,amount_reserved_delta,amount_settled_delta,calls_reserved_delta,calls_settled_delta) VALUES (%s,3,%s,0,0,0,0)',(eid,'unrelated-unregistered-grant'))
  except psycopg.IntegrityError:refused=True
 with psycopg.connect(a2.gateway_dsn) as c:n=c.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM ag_ledger_event_nodes WHERE event_id=%s',(eid,)).fetchone()[0]
 observe('immutable-event-append',{'phase':phase,'refused':refused,'nodes':n,'outbox_unchanged':a2.service.outbox_entry(op)==outbox})
 assert refused and n==3
